chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

A daughter of the brother and a daughter of the sister are not married (as an additional wife) upon the paternal aunt or the maternal aunt, except with their permission; and the paternal aunt and the maternal aunt are married upon a daughter of the brother and a daughter of the sister without their permission.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference in permission required when marrying a niece upon an aunt versus an aunt upon a niece?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the principle of 'idhn' (consent) in polygyny, highlighting a jurisprudential asymmetry where the seniority or status of the aunt grants her veto power over the marriage of her niece, while the niece does not hold reciprocal authority over her aunt. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on maintaining familial harmony and respecting the established hierarchy within the extended family structure during marital unions. It serves as a practical guideline for preventing domestic discord by ensuring that the more senior female relative's preference is prioritized in such arrangements.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘You should neither marry a daughter of the brother, nor a daughter of the sister (as an additional wife) upon the paternal aunt, nor upon the maternal aunt, except with her permission; and the marriage of the paternal aunt and the maternal aunt (as an additional wife) upon a daughter of the brother and a daughter of the sister without her permission’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

You must not marry a daughter of a brother or daughter of a sister as a second wife, the first being her paternal or maternal aunt without their permission and you must not marry a paternal or maternal aunt as a second wife, the first being a daughter of her brother or a daughter of her sister, without their permission.’”
